editorial:
Imagine being a mean gangster who thinks he is the biggest shark in the pond, only to find out his own father is back from the dead as a demon to mess with his head. You get a wild ride as you watch this guy get stabbed in the back by his own crew, leaving him desperate for revenge while a scary spirit pulls the strings. It feels like a gritty crime story mixed with a nightmare, keeping you on edge because you never know if the next threat is a bullet or a ghost.

The acting is top notch and the twists actually land without feeling forced. While some of the slow parts in the middle might test your patience, the scary scenes make up for it with great effects. You should definitely watch this if you love stories where bad people get what they deserve in the most terrifying way possible.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character finally kills the people who betrayed him, but he realizes the demon father was the one manipulating everyone from the start. In the final scene, the spirit takes over his body completely. He doesn't find peace or revenge; instead, he becomes the very monster he was afraid of. The movie ends with him looking in the mirror and seeing his father's face staring back at him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary ghost stories mixed with gang wars.
